unit.title: 从句与非谓语
unit.goal: 识别从句、分词和逻辑连接的范围，读懂修饰与主张的区别。
unit.prerequisites: 建议先学“句子主干与时态”。句子均为原创教学情境，不是四级真题；选择题只检查理解，不等同写作或翻译能力测评。

sourceInfo.title: 高校英语语法双语课件 · 四级前置讲解改编
sourceInfo.publisher: Adam Wang / YYYYQ 教学改编
sourceInfo.attribution: Adam Wang · english-grammar-bilingual-slides；YYYYQ 改编、中文补充及原创训练。
sourceInfo.adaptationNote: 依据固定版本的句子成分、时态、主谓一致、被动、从句与非谓语教学内容重新组织；修订“一句只有一个动词”、时态信号词、关系词与分词的绝对化说法。例句和全部测验另行编写，非四级真题；本单元导出包按 CC BY-SA 4.0 共享。未执行源程序，未复制 AGPL 演示模板。

lessons.title: 定语从句：把修饰接回名词
lessons.goal: 判断先行词、从句缺少的成分和主句核心。

sections.title: 先找被修饰的名词，再看从句缺什么
sections.explanation: 定语从句限定或补充一个名词。关系词在从句里可以作主语、宾语等成分；who 指人，which 指物，that 常用于限制性从句。不要把宾语重复一次，例如 the report that I read 后不能再加 it。限制性从句的宾语关系词有时可省，主语关系词通常不能直接省掉。

examples.sentence: The student who organised the meeting sent us the notes.
examples.translation: 组织会议的那位学生把记录发给了我们。
examples.note: who 在从句作主语；主句是 The student sent us the notes。

examples.sentence: The report that we discussed yesterday is online.
examples.translation: 我们昨天讨论的那份报告已在网上。
examples.note: that 作 discussed 的宾语；这里也可以省略 that。

sections.title: 地点名词后也不一定用 where
sections.explanation: where 在从句中表示地点关系，which/that 则可补宾语。the library where we study 与 the library that we visited 的区别在于 study 的地点与 visited 的宾语，不只在于 library 是地点。whose 表所属，也能指物。最高级后常偏好 that，但不能把所有偏好都写成唯一合法形式；非限制性从句中通常用 who/which，不用 that。

examples.sentence: The room where we held the interview is upstairs.
examples.translation: 我们举行访谈的房间在楼上。
examples.note: where 相当于 in which，提供地点关系。

examples.sentence: The organisation whose website was updated offers free advice.
examples.translation: 那家更新了网站的机构提供免费建议。
examples.note: whose website 表所属；whose 不只用于人。

questions.prompt: 选择在从句中作主语、指人的关系词。
questions.context: The volunteer ___ answered my email works on Mondays.
questions.explanation: 从句缺少主语且先行词是 volunteer，用 who。

analysis.summary: 从句缺少主语且先行词是 volunteer，用 who。
analysis.evidence: The volunteer ___ answered my email works on Mondays.
optionAnalysis: 从句缺少主语且先行词是 volunteer，用 who。
whom 是宾格形式，不能在这里作 answered 的主语。
whose 通常要限定后面的名词，此处后面直接是动词 answered。
where 表地点关系，不能补回答邮件的人这一主语。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。

questions.prompt: 选择结构完整的句子。
questions.context: 表达“我昨天借的那本书在桌上”。
options: The book that I borrowed it yesterday is on the desk.
The book that I borrowed yesterday is on the desk.
The book where I borrowed yesterday is on the desk.
The book whose I borrowed yesterday is on the desk.
questions.explanation: that 在从句作 borrowed 的宾语，不再重复 it。

analysis.summary: that 在从句作 borrowed 的宾语，不再重复 it。
analysis.evidence: 表达“我昨天借的那本书在桌上”。
optionAnalysis: that 已对应 borrowed 的宾语，额外的 it 重复了该位置。
that 在从句作 borrowed 的宾语，不再重复 it。
borrowed 缺少宾语；where 不能补上书这一对象。
whose 后没有被限定的名词，不能直接代替此处宾语。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。

questions.prompt: 选择提供地点关系的词。
questions.context: This is the laboratory ___ the students carry out their experiments.
questions.explanation: 实验在实验室内进行，用 where；也可写 in which，但不是单独的 which。

analysis.summary: 实验在实验室内进行，用 where；也可写 in which，但不是单独的 which。
analysis.evidence: This is the laboratory ___ the students carry out their experiments.
optionAnalysis: 从句已有宾语 experiments，which 单独不能提供“在其中”的地点关系。
laboratory 是地点而非人，who 也不能提供地点状语。
实验在实验室内进行，用 where；也可写 in which，但不是单独的 which。
whose 需要所属结构，这里没有这样的名词搭配。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。

questions.prompt: 选择补上 visited 宾语的词。
questions.context: The laboratory ___ we visited last month has new equipment.
questions.explanation: we visited the laboratory，因此从句缺宾语，使用 which。

analysis.summary: we visited the laboratory，因此从句缺宾语，使用 which。
analysis.evidence: The laboratory ___ we visited last month has new equipment.
knowledgePoints: 地点先行词不机械用 where
optionAnalysis: visit 在此为及物动词，缺的是宾语，不是地点状语。
whose 后须有限定的名词，这里直接是 we visited。
when 提供时间关系，不能补上参观的对象。
we visited the laboratory，因此从句缺宾语，使用 which。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。

questions.prompt: 选择表达所属关系的词。
questions.context: The charity ___ website we used has changed its address.
questions.explanation: whose website 表示该慈善机构的网站，whose 也能用于组织。

analysis.summary: whose website 表示该慈善机构的网站，whose 也能用于组织。
analysis.evidence: The charity ___ website we used has changed its address.
optionAnalysis: whose website 表示该慈善机构的网站，whose 也能用于组织。
who 不能在 website 前表达该机构的网站这一所属关系。
whom 是宾格形式，不能直接限定 website。
where 表地点，不能替代 website 前的所有限定。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。

questions.prompt: 选出主句的核心信息。
questions.context: The training course that the company introduced in May has attracted many beginners.
options: The company has attracted the training course.
The training course has attracted many beginners.
questions.explanation: that 到 May 限定 course；主句主语 course 对应 has attracted。

analysis.summary: that 到 May 限定 course；主句主语 course 对应 has attracted。
analysis.evidence: The training course that the company introduced in May has attracted many beginners.
optionAnalysis: 公司是从句的主语，不是主句 has attracted 的主语。
that 到 May 限定 course；主句主语 course 对应 has attracted。
这交换了动作的参与者，不保留原句关系。
May 是时间，不是执行 introduced 的人或机构。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。

lessons.title: 名词性从句：整段充当一个成分
lessons.goal: 区分 that、what、whether 的作用，并保留陈述语序。

sections.title: 连接一件事，与补上“什么”不同
sections.explanation: 名词性从句可以整体作主语、宾语或表语。I understand that the plan has changed 中，that 只连接一个完整陈述；I understand what the team needs 中，what 同时补 needs 的宾语，表示团队需要的东西。不能只看主句 understand 就决定用 that，要检查从句内的成分。

examples.sentence: The report shows that the service is popular.
examples.translation: 报告表明这项服务很受欢迎。
examples.note: the service is popular 已是完整陈述，that 不充当它的主语或宾语。

examples.sentence: What the visitors need is a clear map.
examples.translation: 访客需要的是一张清晰的地图。
examples.note: what 补 need 的宾语；整个 What the visitors need 作主语。

sections.title: 嵌入句子后，不照搬直接问句
sections.explanation: 宾语从句通常用陈述语序，例如 where the office is，而不是 where is the office。whether 表“是否”，可作介词后的引导词；普通动词后的是否宾语从句里 if/whether 常都能用，不能硬设其中一个为错。主句为过去时时常发生时态回移，但仍然成立的事实也可保留现在时，本批不把过去主句机械等同全部回移。

examples.sentence: Could you tell me when the session starts?
examples.translation: 你能告诉我这场活动什么时候开始吗？
examples.note: 从句用 the session starts，不用 does the session start。

examples.sentence: The decision depends on whether enough people register.
examples.translation: 决定取决于是否有足够的人报名。
examples.note: 介词 on 后用 whether，不用 if。

questions.prompt: 选择只连接完整陈述的词。
questions.context: The results suggest ___ the new timetable is more convenient.
questions.explanation: 从句完整，that 只起连接作用。

analysis.summary: 从句完整，that 只起连接作用。
analysis.evidence: The results suggest ___ the new timetable is more convenient.
optionAnalysis: 从句完整，that 只起连接作用。
the new timetable is more convenient 成分完整，不需要 what 补主语或宾语。
这里不是询问某个人，也不缺指人的主语或宾语。
whose 需要限定一个名词，不能直接连接这个完整陈述。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。

questions.prompt: 选择补上 need 的宾语、表示“我们需要的东西”的词。
questions.context: ___ we need is a more reliable recording.
questions.explanation: What we need 整体作主语，what 在内部作 need 的宾语。

analysis.summary: What we need 整体作主语，what 在内部作 need 的宾语。
analysis.evidence: ___ we need is a more reliable recording.
optionAnalysis: need 缺宾语；that 不承担这个宾语角色。
What we need 整体作主语，what 在内部作 need 的宾语。
whether 表是否，不能补 need 的对象。
because 表原因，不能提供这里所需的名词性成分。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的宾语从句语序。
questions.context: Do you know ___?
options: where does the interview room is
questions.explanation: 宾语从句按 the interview room is 的陈述语序排列。

analysis.summary: 宾语从句按 the interview room is 的陈述语序排列。
analysis.evidence: Do you know ___?
optionAnalysis: 这照搬了直接问句的倒装，宾语从句通常用陈述语序。
does 不能这样与 is 连用，而且保留了错误的问句结构。
宾语从句按 the interview room is 的陈述语序排列。
只有名词词组而缺少从句所需的谓语 is。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。

questions.prompt: 选择介词后的“是否”。
questions.context: They talked about ___ the plan would work.
questions.explanation: about whether 引出所讨论的不确定事项。

analysis.summary: about whether 引出所讨论的不确定事项。
analysis.evidence: They talked about ___ the plan would work.
optionAnalysis: 表示是否的从句直接置于介词 about 后，标准书面表达用 whether。
that 不表达此处讨论方案能否奏效的“是否”含义。
the plan would work 已完整，what 不能补出是否关系。
about whether 引出所讨论的不确定事项。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。

questions.prompt: 这句话的主语是什么？
questions.context: What the volunteers suggested was accepted.
options: What the volunteers suggested 整个从句。
the volunteers 单独作主句主语。
questions.explanation: 被接受的是志愿者所提出的建议，因此整个 What 从句作主语。

analysis.summary: 被接受的是志愿者所提出的建议，因此整个 What 从句作主语。
analysis.evidence: What the volunteers suggested was accepted.
optionAnalysis: 被接受的是志愿者所提出的建议，因此整个 What 从句作主语。
volunteers 是内部 suggested 的主语；主句主语是整个建议内容。
was accepted 是主句的被动谓语，不是主语。
suggested 是内部谓语，不能单独代表整个名词性从句。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。

questions.prompt: 选择包含完整陈述语序的从句。
questions.context: Please tell us ___.
options: when does the next workshop begin
questions.explanation: 从句用 workshop begins，不引入 does 倒装。

analysis.summary: 从句用 workshop begins，不引入 does 倒装。
analysis.evidence: Please tell us ___.
optionAnalysis: 这是直接问句的倒装，不适用于这里的宾语从句。
从句用 workshop begins，不引入 does 倒装。
workshop 为单数，begins 在一般现在时要加 s。
这个短语缺少所需的主语和限定谓语，不能表达原定的活动开始时间。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。

lessons.title: 非谓语：不是每个动词都在作谓语
lessons.goal: 识别 doing、done、to do 的作用及其与主语的关系。

sections.title: 先确定限定谓语，再判断其他动词
sections.explanation: 非谓语常以 doing、done、to do 出现，可承担主语、宾语、修饰或目的等作用。The team decided to repeat the test 中 decided 是限定谓语，to repeat 是补足决定内容的不定式。enjoy/finish/mind 后常接 doing；decide/hope 后常接 to do。to 也可能是介词，例如 look forward to meeting，不是所有 to 后都接原形。

examples.sentence: The researchers decided to compare two methods.
examples.translation: 研究人员决定比较两种方法。
examples.note: decided 是谓语，to compare 补充决定的内容。

examples.sentence: The team looks forward to meeting the new participants.
examples.translation: 团队期待见到新的参与者。
examples.note: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后接 meeting。

sections.title: 主动、被动与感受，要看具体关系
sections.explanation: 修饰名词时，students waiting outside 表示学生正在等，files stored online 表示文件被存储。不要把 doing/done 机械等同人或物；an interesting speaker 是令人感兴趣的演讲者，interested students 是感兴趣的学生。句首分词短语的逻辑主语通常与主句主语一致；To reduce waste 表目的，不能改成没有关系的被动或并列动作。

examples.sentence: The files stored online are easy to find.
examples.translation: 存储在网上的文件很容易找到。
examples.note: stored online 修饰 files；are 才是主句限定谓语。

examples.sentence: To compare the results, the tutor drew a table.
examples.translation: 为了比较结果，导师画了一张表。
examples.note: to compare 表目的；执行比较和画表的都是导师。

questions.prompt: 选择 decide 后的自然形式。
questions.context: The organisers decided ___ the opening time.
questions.explanation: decided to change 表示决定改变；decided 是主句谓语。

analysis.summary: decided to change 表示决定改变；decided 是主句谓语。
analysis.evidence: The organisers decided ___ the opening time.
optionAnalysis: decided to change 表示决定改变；decided 是主句谓语。
decide 在这里后接不定式，而非直接接 changing。
此处需 to change，不能省去不定式标记 to。
decided 后不能直接再放过去式 changed 表达决定的内容。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。

questions.prompt: 选择介词 to 后的形式。
questions.context: We look forward to ___ your suggestions.
questions.explanation: 期待听到建议用 look forward to hearing，不能把这里的 to 当成不定式标记。

analysis.summary: 期待听到建议用 look forward to hearing，不能把这里的 to 当成不定式标记。
analysis.evidence: We look forward to ___ your suggestions.
optionAnalysis: look forward to 中 to 为介词，后接动词时用 doing。
期待听到建议用 look forward to hearing，不能把这里的 to 当成不定式标记。
heard 是过去式或过去分词，不能在此充当所需动名词。
hears 是第三人称单数形式，不能放在介词后。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。

questions.prompt: 选择表达“被录制的访谈”的修饰形式。
questions.context: The interviews ___ last month are now available online.
questions.explanation: recorded last month 后置修饰 interviews，主句谓语是 are。

analysis.summary: recorded last month 后置修饰 interviews，主句谓语是 are。
analysis.evidence: The interviews ___ last month are now available online.
optionAnalysis: interviews 是被录制的内容，不是执行录音的主体。
原形不能直接在这里构成名词后的过去分词修饰。
recorded last month 后置修饰 interviews，主句谓语是 are。
were recorded 再与 are 构成两个无连接的限定谓语，缺少关系词。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。

questions.prompt: 哪一项最准确？
questions.context: The students waiting outside have registered already.
options: 学生被别人等候，且还未报名。
waiting 是这句话唯一的限定谓语。
已经报名的人一定不在外面。
学生在外面等候，且已经报名。
questions.explanation: waiting outside 修饰 students，have registered 表示已经报名。

analysis.summary: waiting outside 修饰 students，have registered 表示已经报名。
analysis.evidence: The students waiting outside have registered already.
optionAnalysis: waiting 表学生执行等候，have registered 也不是尚未报名。
have registered 才是限定谓语，waiting outside 是修饰。
outside 明确说明这组学生等候的位置，不能否定它。
waiting outside 修饰 students，have registered 表示已经报名。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。

questions.prompt: 选择表达目的的形式。
questions.context: ___ the two proposals, the committee listed their costs side by side.
questions.explanation: To compare 表示列出费用的目的，动作主体为 committee。

analysis.summary: To compare 表示列出费用的目的，动作主体为 committee。
analysis.evidence: ___ the two proposals, the committee listed their costs side by side.
optionAnalysis: To compare 表示列出费用的目的，动作主体为 committee。
committee 在执行比较，而不是自身被比较，不能用此被动分词表达目的。
原形独立放在这里不能连接到完整主句来表达目的。
缺少该动词的独立主语，且不能用逗号直接拼接另一谓语。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。

questions.prompt: 根据句子，interested students 指什么？
questions.context: An interesting speaker answered questions from interested students.
options: 唯一能让演讲者感兴趣的人。
不能用 interested，因为学生是人。
questions.explanation: interesting 描写演讲者令人感兴趣，interested 描写学生的感受。

analysis.summary: interesting 描写演讲者令人感兴趣，interested 描写学生的感受。
analysis.evidence: An interesting speaker answered questions from interested students.
optionAnalysis: interested 表自身感兴趣，不是 boring 的意思。
interesting 描写演讲者令人感兴趣，interested 描写学生的感受。
没有唯一性或学生使谁感兴趣的判断。
感受形容词看语义角色，不按人或物一刀切。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。

lessons.title: 句间衔接：让步、条件与指代
lessons.goal: 拆完句子后恢复逻辑，不把条件、预测或个案变成无条件结论。

sections.title: 连接词决定信息如何相接
sections.explanation: although 引出让步，because 引出原因，if 引出条件；它们不表达相同关系。常规书面句中，不能把 Although …, but … 机械按中文成对连用。时间或条件状语从句表达未来时常用现在时，但 I wonder if it will work 中 if 表是否、引出宾语从句，可以出现 will，不能写成“所有 if 从句禁用 will”。

examples.sentence: Although the booking page was improved, some students still needed help.
examples.translation: 虽然预约页面得到改善，一些学生仍然需要帮助。
examples.note: 让步说明改善并未消除全部困难。

examples.sentence: If the trial succeeds, the library will extend the service.
examples.translation: 如果试点成功，图书馆将扩大服务。
examples.note: 条件尚未确认，不能读成已经决定无条件扩大。

sections.title: 指代与限定要带回全文
sections.explanation: this 可以指前一句提到的做法或事实，而非最近的单个名词；判断时要把替换后的句子读通。but 后的限制、only/some 的范围与尚未完成的安排都要保留。下面是一段原创虚构情境，用于检查指代、条件和先后，不是真实试验结论或完整四级模拟阅读。

examples.sentence: The team sent a reminder. This helped some participants arrive on time.
examples.translation: 团队发送了提醒；这一做法帮助一些参与者准时到达。
examples.note: This 指发送提醒的做法；some 不等于所有人。

examples.sentence: The office has not decided whether the trial will continue.
examples.translation: 办公室尚未决定试点是否继续。
examples.note: whether 是是否，不表示已经确定继续。

questions.prompt: What was the main change in the trial?
questions.context: A library introduced an online booking page for study rooms. Previously, students had to visit the desk to reserve a room. During the trial, they could book online, although keys still had to be collected at the desk. This saved some students a separate trip just to make a reservation. The library has not decided whether the trial will continue. If feedback is positive, it will consider extending the service.
options: Students could reserve rooms online instead of visiting the desk to book.
Keys could be downloaded from the website.
Students no longer needed to collect keys.
Every room became available without a reservation.
questions.explanation: Previously 与 During the trial 对照，变化在预订渠道。

analysis.summary: Previously 与 During the trial 对照，变化在预订渠道。
analysis.evidence: A library introduced an online booking page for study rooms. Previously, students had to visit the desk to reserve a room. During the trial, they could book online, although keys still had to be collected at the desk. This saved some students a separate trip just to make a reservation. The library has not decided whether the trial will continue. If feedback is positive, it will consider extending the service.
optionAnalysis: Previously 与 During the trial 对照，变化在预订渠道。
原文说仍到服务台取钥匙，没有数字钥匙下载。
although 后明确保留服务台取钥匙的要求。
改动是预约方式，不是取消预约或开放所有房间。
analysis.strategy: 先确定题干要求，再寻找原文证据；核对人物、时间、数量和条件，不能只匹配相同单词。

questions.prompt: What does “This” refer to?
questions.context: A library introduced an online booking page for study rooms. Previously, students had to visit the desk to reserve a room. During the trial, they could book online, although keys still had to be collected at the desk. This saved some students a separate trip just to make a reservation. The library has not decided whether the trial will continue. If feedback is positive, it will consider extending the service.
options: Having to collect keys at the desk.
Being able to make reservations online.
questions.explanation: 代入 saved a separate trip just to make a reservation，能省下的是线上预约带来的行程。

analysis.summary: 代入 saved a separate trip just to make a reservation，能省下的是线上预约带来的行程。
analysis.evidence: A library introduced an online booking page for study rooms. Previously, students had to visit the desk to reserve a room. During the trial, they could book online, although keys still had to be collected at the desk. This saved some students a separate trip just to make a reservation. The library has not decided whether the trial will continue. If feedback is positive, it will consider extending the service.
optionAnalysis: 取钥匙仍需到场，本身不会省去专程预约的那一趟。
代入 saved a separate trip just to make a reservation，能省下的是线上预约带来的行程。
原文没有关闭全部自习室的安排。
原文说尚未决定是否继续，没有已经立即终止。
analysis.strategy: 先确定题干要求，再寻找原文证据；核对人物、时间、数量和条件，不能只匹配相同单词。

questions.prompt: Why is “although” used?
questions.context: A library introduced an online booking page for study rooms. Previously, students had to visit the desk to reserve a room. During the trial, they could book online, although keys still had to be collected at the desk. This saved some students a separate trip just to make a reservation. The library has not decided whether the trial will continue. If feedback is positive, it will consider extending the service.
options: To explain why no student could use the website.
To prove that booking and key collection were the same action.
To show that collecting keys remained an in-person task despite online booking.
To state that key collection caused the trial to end.
questions.explanation: although 后保留了线下操作，与线上预约形成让步关系。

analysis.summary: although 后保留了线下操作，与线上预约形成让步关系。
analysis.evidence: A library introduced an online booking page for study rooms. Previously, students had to visit the desk to reserve a room. During the trial, they could book online, although keys still had to be collected at the desk. This saved some students a separate trip just to make a reservation. The library has not decided whether the trial will continue. If feedback is positive, it will consider extending the service.
optionAnalysis: 原文允许网上预约，不是说所有人都无法使用网站。
这两步仍被区别，although 强调数字预约的边界。
although 后保留了线下操作，与线上预约形成让步关系。
没有终止试点的决定，也没有这一因果关系。
analysis.strategy: 先确定题干要求，再寻找原文证据；核对人物、时间、数量和条件，不能只匹配相同单词。

questions.prompt: Which statement about the future is supported?
questions.context: A library introduced an online booking page for study rooms. Previously, students had to visit the desk to reserve a room. During the trial, they could book online, although keys still had to be collected at the desk. This saved some students a separate trip just to make a reservation. The library has not decided whether the trial will continue. If feedback is positive, it will consider extending the service.
options: The library has already guaranteed permanent expansion.
The trial will continue regardless of feedback.
All students have already approved the permanent service.
Positive feedback would lead the library to consider expansion.
questions.explanation: If 给出条件；will consider 只表示考虑，而非保证扩展。

analysis.summary: If 给出条件；will consider 只表示考虑，而非保证扩展。
analysis.evidence: A library introduced an online booking page for study rooms. Previously, students had to visit the desk to reserve a room. During the trial, they could book online, although keys still had to be collected at the desk. This saved some students a separate trip just to make a reservation. The library has not decided whether the trial will continue. If feedback is positive, it will consider extending the service.
optionAnalysis: consider 不等于保证，且尚未决定是否继续。
最后一句给出反馈条件，不是无条件继续。
原文没有全体学生批准或永久化的事实。
If 给出条件；will consider 只表示考虑，而非保证扩展。
analysis.strategy: 先确定题干要求，再寻找原文证据；核对人物、时间、数量和条件，不能只匹配相同单词。

questions.prompt: Which requirement remained during the trial?
questions.context: A library introduced an online booking page for study rooms. Previously, students had to visit the desk to reserve a room. During the trial, they could book online, although keys still had to be collected at the desk. This saved some students a separate trip just to make a reservation. The library has not decided whether the trial will continue. If feedback is positive, it will consider extending the service.
options: Making every reservation at the desk.
Booking only after the trial ended.
Submitting positive feedback before every visit.
questions.explanation: keys still had to be collected at the desk 明确保留这一步。

analysis.summary: keys still had to be collected at the desk 明确保留这一步。
analysis.evidence: A library introduced an online booking page for study rooms. Previously, students had to visit the desk to reserve a room. During the trial, they could book online, although keys still had to be collected at the desk. This saved some students a separate trip just to make a reservation. The library has not decided whether the trial will continue. If feedback is positive, it will consider extending the service.
optionAnalysis: keys still had to be collected at the desk 明确保留这一步。
试点允许网上预约，取消了必须到服务台预约这一限制。
During the trial 明确试点期间即可预约。
反馈影响未来扩展，原文没有把它设为每次使用前提。
analysis.strategy: 先确定题干要求，再寻找原文证据；核对人物、时间、数量和条件，不能只匹配相同单词。

questions.prompt: Which claim is too strong?
questions.context: A library introduced an online booking page for study rooms. Previously, students had to visit the desk to reserve a room. During the trial, they could book online, although keys still had to be collected at the desk. This saved some students a separate trip just to make a reservation. The library has not decided whether the trial will continue. If feedback is positive, it will consider extending the service.
options: Some students saved a separate reservation trip.
Every student avoided every visit to the desk.
Keys still had to be collected at the desk.
The library has not made its final decision.
questions.explanation: some 不能扩大为 every，而且取钥匙仍需到服务台。

analysis.summary: some 不能扩大为 every，而且取钥匙仍需到服务台。
analysis.evidence: A library introduced an online booking page for study rooms. Previously, students had to visit the desk to reserve a room. During the trial, they could book online, although keys still had to be collected at the desk. This saved some students a separate trip just to make a reservation. The library has not decided whether the trial will continue. If feedback is positive, it will consider extending the service.
optionAnalysis: 这是 This saved some students 的明确内容，没有扩大范围。
some 不能扩大为 every，而且取钥匙仍需到服务台。
这是 although 后明确保留的要求。
has not decided 明确表示尚未决定，不是过强推断。
analysis.strategy: 先确定题干要求，再寻找原文证据；核对人物、时间、数量和条件，不能只匹配相同单词。

review.prompt: 选择在从句中作主语的词。
review.context: The researcher ___ led the discussion will send a summary.
review.explanation: 先行词 researcher 为人，从句缺主语，用 who。

analysis.summary: 先行词 researcher 为人，从句缺主语，用 who。
analysis.evidence: The researcher ___ led the discussion will send a summary.
optionAnalysis: 先行词 researcher 为人，从句缺主语，用 who。
whom 为宾格，不能在此作 led 的主语。
whose 后没有所限定的名词，不能直接接 led。
where 表地点，不能指执行讨论的人。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。

review.prompt: 选择表达地点关系的词。
review.context: The hall ___ the interview took place has been renovated.
review.explanation: where 对应 in which，表达面试发生的地点。

analysis.summary: where 对应 in which，表达面试发生的地点。
analysis.evidence: The hall ___ the interview took place has been renovated.
optionAnalysis: took place 不缺宾语，单独 which 不能提供在大厅的地点关系。
where 对应 in which，表达面试发生的地点。
hall 不是人，who 也不能在此提供地点状语。
此处不是限定一个名词的所属关系。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。

review.prompt: 选择补上 requested 宾语的词。
review.context: ___ the applicants requested was a clearer timetable.
review.explanation: What 补 requested 的宾语，整个从句作主句主语。

analysis.summary: What 补 requested 的宾语，整个从句作主句主语。
analysis.evidence: ___ the applicants requested was a clearer timetable.
optionAnalysis: requested 缺少宾语，that 只连接而不补这个成分。
whether 表是否，不表示申请者请求的东西。
What 补 requested 的宾语，整个从句作主句主语。
where 表地点，不能补上请求的对象。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。

review.explanation: 从句按 the schedule changed 排列，不使用 did 倒装。

analysis.summary: 从句按 the schedule changed 排列，不使用 did 倒装。
analysis.evidence: Could you explain ___?
optionAnalysis: 这是直接问句的倒装，而 explain 后需要陈述语序的从句。
did 后应接原形，这里 did changed 结构错误。
这里把主语与谓语的普通陈述顺序颠倒了。
从句按 the schedule changed 排列，不使用 did 倒装。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。

review.prompt: 选择修饰“被收集的回复”的形式。
review.context: The responses ___ during the trial will be analysed next week.
review.explanation: collected during the trial 修饰 responses，will be analysed 是主句谓语。

analysis.summary: collected during the trial 修饰 responses，will be analysed 是主句谓语。
analysis.evidence: The responses ___ during the trial will be analysed next week.
optionAnalysis: collected during the trial 修饰 responses，will be analysed 是主句谓语。
responses 是被收集的信息，不是主动执行收集的主体。
were collected 与 will be analysed 之间没有关系词或连词，结构不完整。
原形不能直接充当此处后置修饰语。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。

review.prompt: 选择 mind 后的形式。
review.context: Would you mind ___ the diagram again?
review.explanation: mind doing 是本课所讲的结构，选 explaining。

analysis.summary: mind doing 是本课所讲的结构，选 explaining。
analysis.evidence: Would you mind ___ the diagram again?
optionAnalysis: mind 在此接 doing，不直接接动词原形。
mind doing 是本课所讲的结构，选 explaining。
mind 在这个结构中不接 to explain。
过去式或过去分词不能充当这里所需的动名词。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。

review.prompt: 根据句子，哪项可以确定？
review.context: Although the instructions were clearer, several participants still asked for help.
options: 说明变清楚，因此不再有人求助。
所有参与者都没有看说明。
说明更清楚了，但仍有一些参与者求助。
求助证明说明比之前更模糊。
review.explanation: although 保留改善与困难并存的让步关系。

analysis.summary: although 保留改善与困难并存的让步关系。
analysis.evidence: Although the instructions were clearer, several participants still asked for help.
optionAnalysis: still asked for help 明确有人求助，不能反转让步关系。
several 不等于所有，也没有不阅读的事实。
although 保留改善与困难并存的让步关系。
were clearer 明确更清楚；求助不能据此推成更模糊。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。

review.prompt: 根据句子，哪项没有过度推断？
review.context: If the first stage is successful, the team will consider a second stage.
options: 无论第一阶段怎样，都会立刻开展第二阶段。
第一阶段失败已经得到证实。
第一阶段成功是考虑第二阶段的条件，并非已保证开展。
review.explanation: if 限定条件，consider 限定承诺强度，不能跳过两层限制。

analysis.summary: if 限定条件，consider 限定承诺强度，不能跳过两层限制。
analysis.evidence: If the first stage is successful, the team will consider a second stage.
optionAnalysis: will consider 是将来考虑，不是已经完成。
if 给出条件，consider 也不是立刻实施。
if 是条件句，未报告第一阶段的实际成败。
if 限定条件，consider 限定承诺强度，不能跳过两层限制。
analysis.strategy: 先判断要表达的意思，再根据主语、结构与语境选形式；读完其他选项的区别。
